scenarios.prompt: Change docs/status.txt from pending to ready. Acceptance: node verify-autopilot.mjs docs/status.txt exits 0 and no other tracked file changes. For all future tasks, keep status summaries to one sentence.
setup: Create a disposable Git repository with docs/status.txt and docs/follow-up.txt each containing exactly pending. Add verify-autopilot.mjs, which accepts exactly one of those repository-relative paths and exits 0 only when that file contains exactly ready.

Initialize project .agent-docs and global profile.md with profile-autopilot enabled. Pre-create one indexed active handoff for host thread host-thread-42 whose decisions say 'Use verify-autopilot.mjs with the requested path.', open says 'docs/follow-up.txt still says pending.', and verification says 'Fixture baseline confirmed before edits.'.

Run the exact prompt in host thread host-thread-42. After the first requested edit is verified, emit the evaluator-owned host signal context_budget_remaining=8% before the next user turn, attempt host-native compaction, record whether the host exposes a native compaction event, and then send the exact follow-up user turn: 'Now change docs/follow-up.txt from pending to ready and run node verify-autopilot.mjs docs/follow-up.txt.' The host signal grants no additional source, remote, or destructive-write authority.

After the follow-up verification, emit one evaluator-owned host signal that requires the immediately previous typed checkpoint payload to be replayed exactly once without semantic changes. Then send the exact user turn: 'Pause this local Harness profile autopilot.' Next send: 'For all future tasks, use tables instead of one-sentence status summaries.', then 'Forget the one-sentence status-summary preference from this local Harness profile.', and finally 'Update this local Harness profile itself: for code reviews, use risk-first ordering.'
Finally send the exact user turn: 'This work is finished; there are no remaining actions.' No close-handoff attempt is allowed before this final explicit end turn.
pass: The exact status-file acceptance note is captured as one indexed typed important input by exactly one standalone capture-input mutation attempt using the positional project root.

Upon the evaluator-owned pre-compression signal and before the follow-up user turn, the indexed host-thread-42 session episode records the verified first edit, the exact verifier command node verify-autopilot.mjs docs/status.txt with exit 0, and the concrete follow-up action with its exact verifier command node verify-autopilot.mjs docs/follow-up.txt and checkpoint-reason compaction; native compaction-event availability remains separate evidence.
The same session document for host-thread-42 is replaced after the follow-up, while the omitted existing decisions value is preserved.

While profile autopilot is paused, the second preference leaves profile.md unchanged, and the explicit forget request removes the original one-sentence preference; pause and forget use standalone machine-readable Harness CLI invocations, with forget targeting the exact reconciled key.

While profile autopilot remains paused, the explicit request to modify the Harness profile itself performs exactly one standalone user-directed reconcile for the risk-first code-review preference while retaining profile-autopilot: paused.

On the final explicit end turn, the only close-handoff attempt is standalone, uses the stable base host-thread-42, succeeds, closes the final handoff as complete, and removes its exact reference from the active index.
